CustomField.description: SS-4495 - Field to capture the cloud provider. ITSC-00291940 - Field to default to blank and only OrderOps (use Deal Desk profile) can update it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This field should be blank - it can only be updated by Order Ops for initial tenant builds. It's only editable by order ops and it overrides the cloud provider that Provisioner defaults to (via license file), for when deals come through a given cloud marketplace.
CustomField.label: Cloud Provider
